Uninstall the Pulumi analyzer plugin

## Synopsis

```text
Removes the finfocus Pulumi Analyzer plugin from the plugin directory.

All analyzer-finfocus-v* directories are removed, cleaning up any installed
versions of the analyzer.
```

```text
finfocus analyzer uninstall [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # Uninstall the analyzer
  finfocus analyzer uninstall

  # Uninstall from a custom directory
  finfocus analyzer uninstall --target-dir /opt/pulumi/plugins
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help[=true|false]   help for uninstall
      --target-dir string   Override Pulumi plugin directory
```
